videos.title: Roadworthy Rescues
videos.description: Derek goes off the deep end with an '80s icon, the DeLorean; it's been wrecked, painted, and doesn't run, but Derek and his friends change all that with a good old junkyard LS.

videos.title: Roadworthy Rescues
videos.description: Amid the cornfields of Michigan, Derek discovers a '37 Chevy Deluxe he wants to drive to GM headquarters in Detroit; but it's been off the road for over 20 years and is going to put up a fight to make the 150-mile journey.

videos.title: Roadworthy Rescues
videos.description: Derek and his brother Sean head back to their family farm in North Dakota; intent on building a goin'-to-town rig for the old farmstead, they dig out a 1971 Chevrolet Chevelle sedan that's buried in cow pies and has a waterlogged engine.

videos.title: Roadworthy Rescues
videos.description: In need of a new riding lawn mower, Derek heads east to find himself a 1950 Ford 8N tractor; with a cracked engine block and a bees' nest for a battery, Derek will have to revisit his farming routes to make this implement operational.

videos.title: Vegas Rat Rods
videos.description: Steve and the Welder Up crew have to get creative when they're tasked with building an iron-worker themed rat rod that doubles as a work truck; Justin makes a big mistake; Steve tries to flip a beat-up 1967 Coronet that he finds in a junkyard.

videos.title: Vegas Rat Rods
videos.description: With only two weeks left to go, the Welder Up crew still has to build an engine for Tyrone's Iron Rod truck and install it and then re-cut the frame to add shocks.

videos.title: Hot Rod Garage
videos.description: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa swap in a junkyard-fresh 5.3L on a low-buck drag project, the Bonemaro; they perform some critical upgrades along the way.

videos.title: My Classic Car
videos.description: Dennis travels to Sweden for a car and boat show, then he'll head over to Nashville to check out a couple of classic trucks.

videos.title: Roadkill
videos.description: The street freak 1975 AMC has had failures, but now the Hemi-powered Gremlin finally completes a road trip; Freiburger and Finnegan drive from Detroit to St. Louis and finally give the Hemi Gremmie the trip it deserves.

videos.title: Truck U
videos.description: Truck U puts the final touches on a Dodge D150 from Two Guys Garage. From protection under the bed, sound and heat insulation, better stance and firmer steering, this truck will finally be exactly what the owner always wanted.

videos.title: Garage Squad
videos.description: Restoring a Grand National takes a hard left turn; a 1987 Grand National owned the road in the 1980s, but has fallen on hard times.

videos.title: Garage Squad
videos.description: A 1968 Chevrolet El Camino requires new brakes, a vital engine refresh and exhaust work to get it back on the road.

videos.title: Garage Squad
videos.description: Time and storage take a toll on a 1969 Dodge Charger that has remained in its original owner's family since it rolled off the lot.

videos.title: Two Guys Garage
videos.description: Willie B and Kevin unveil an incredible wide-body C10 that could be their most ambitious project ever. The goal is to transform it into a 1,000-hp street machine, combining cutting-edge engineering, premium aftermarket parts and show-stopping style.

videos.title: Build for Off-Road
videos.description: Ian transforms a 2024 Ford F-250 into a better-looking, more capable tow rig. Along the way, we'll take a closer look at some common trouble spots found in modern Ford diesel trucks and explore upgrades that improve both performance and functionality.

videos.title: Two Guys Garage
videos.description: Willie and Kevin help the owner of a 1955 Nomad wagon complete this lifelong project and get it ready to go back on the track.

videos.title: Hot Rod Garage
videos.description: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa are reunited with the Crown Hick, a 1966 F-100 sitting on an entire 2007 Crown Victoria frame, with suspension upgrades and a supercharger.

videos.title: Truck U
videos.description: The Chevy 2500 AT4 is back in the shop for some maintenance and additional power after adding larger 37-inch tires. We will then go to a small town to see semi-trucks throw down to see who can tow 120,000 pounds uphill the quickest.

videos.title: Hot Rod Garage
videos.description: Tony and Lucky stray way off the beaten path with a 1990 Plymouth Voyager five-speed, turbocharged minivan; the boys refresh the suspension, engine and accessories until this 250,000-mile van is as good as new.

videos.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
videos.description: Newbern and Cotten discover a gem which is not a typical American muscle with a turbocharged Eagle Talon; Shea Seefeldt challenges the guys on a rally course with his LS-swapped Subaru.

videos.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
videos.description: Newbern surprises Cotten with a mint 1984 G-body and an '80s-style, stock-car-inspired build to take on an actual former cup car around the circle track.

videos.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
videos.description: Cotten's Pro Street big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada's engine dies on Roadkill; things don't go as planned as the guys attempt to add a giant blower and bigger tires, and bring the car back to its 1990s-era glory.

videos.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
videos.description: When Grave Digger himself calls you out, there's only one thing to do, send it; the guys send it by transforming a stock 1972 Jeep into a Tough Truck competitor to challenge the field at Dennis Anderson's Muddy Motorsports Park in North Carolina.

videos.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
videos.description: The guys attempt to build their '99 Trans Am into a 200-mph club member to compete at the Arkansas Mile; Keith Turk helps the guys find out how much horsepower they need to make, and they begin one of their most complex builds yet.

videos.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
videos.description: The guys take on Hot Rod Garage's Lucky Costa and improve their shop truck Pigpen; it's their LS7-powered 1950 GMC 100 on an S15 chassis versus Lucky's 1966 Ford F-100 with a supercharged 4.6L on a police car chassis known as the Crown Hick.

videos.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
videos.description: The guys take a 1960 Chevrolet Biscayne and completely overhaul the suspension with an unconventional setup and supercharge the engine to make up time against a '66 Mustang GT350.

videos.title: Faster With Newbern and Cotten
videos.description: Newbern and Cotten take a G-Body to new heights when they swap a third-gen Hemi into a 1984 Monte Carlo.

videos.description: What does it take to get a Trans Am to 200 mph? The guys swing for the fences in an attempt at the elusive top speed of 200 mph.

videos.title: Motorhead Garage
videos.description: If it goes, Dave Dobson and the Motorhead Garage crew are fans. They bring you their love for all things motorized as they modify cars, trucks, ATVs and motorcycles using aftermarket equipment, ranging from the tried-and-true to the innovative and new.

videos.title: Garage Squad

videos.title: Build for Off-Road
videos.description: Ian tackles some of the design issues on his FJ45 project, making the necessary changes to get the build back on track. With a redesigned exhaust system and upgraded brakes, the FJ45 is ready to start moving forward again.

videos.title: Build for Off-Road
videos.description: After coming down from the top of the World, the team takes on one of Moab's trails, Hell's Revenge; with drop-offs, steep climbs and the infamous Hell's Gate, this trail puts both the rigs and drivers to the ultimate test.

videos.title: Hot Rod Garage
videos.description: Lucky and Tony upgrade a '66 Chevelle with a 475-hp NA LS engine, constructed with AFR heads and a rack-and-pinion conversion to make the drive even better.

videos.description: The crew transforms a 1958 Chevy Apache into a badass Vintage Dirt Bike Hauler; Steve jumps at the chance to bring Evel Knievel's Formula 1 Dragster back to life.

videos.title: Vegas Rat Rods
videos.description: With the delivery date for the ultimate Vintage Dirt Bike Hauler imminent, Steve pushes his crew to complete his vision; Welder Up's reputation for building the meanest and fastest rat rods is challenged.

videos.title: Vegas Rat Rods
videos.description: Steve is asked to build a scary villain rat rod in three weeks and a vintage-inspired charity bike for military veterans in two weeks; Steve worries when the villain car frame takes longer than expected and the Vet Bike won't start.

videos.title: Vegas Rat Rods
videos.description: Steve and the crew commit to meeting the original Superhero build time and delivering the Villain Rat Rod in three weeks; with no sign of a transmission, it doesn't look as though the crew will escape the clutches of this perilous deadline.

videos.title: Vegas Rat Rods
videos.description: Steve agrees to build a crazy 1970s-era gasser racecar for a U.S. Navy veteran; Steve tries to make money by restoring and flipping a Prohibition-era bootlegger Model A truck for a Las Vegas police captain.

videos.description: MLB pitcher Jacob deGrom asks the crew to revamp his OBS Ford; the diesel guys convert a rare British Land Rover Defender from right-hand drive to left-hand drive for a client.

videos.title: Graveyard Carz
videos.description: It's heavy metal with Shane, Jason and Will, as they mod a donor car to save a possibly one-of-one, numbers-matching '70 GTX; meanwhile, Mr. Original Equipment dips into the aftermarket when Mark and Brian convert a 'Cuda to four-wheel disc brakes.

videos.title: Graveyard Carz
videos.description: The pushrods have arrived, and Mark teams up with his cousin to finish his engine build; but with Dougie's history of timing trouble, will this 440 snorkeler fire up without a hitch? Meanwhile, Will adopts Mark's antics to train his son Brody.

videos.title: Graveyard Carz
videos.description: Doug reveals his insider tricks, as he disassembles the heat-treated 440 Magnum from a 1970 Charger that was incinerated in a California wildfire; Mark installs a front clip on his personal 1970 Charger.

videos.title: FantomWorks
videos.description: Larry wants to drive his uncle's '59 Cadillac DeVille, but the car has spent decades baking in the Arizona sun; Brian spent years gathering parts to restore his grandfather's '60 Bel Air only to find that he's still missing critical components.

videos.title: FantomWorks
videos.description: Dave traded for his dream '57 Corvette over three decades ago, but his plans to build it have, so far, come to nothing; Ken picked a rare 1954 Kaiser Darrin from his father's collection and hopes FantomWorks can reverse the hands of time.

videos.title: Iron Resurrection
videos.description: Fitment issues in the engine bay leave the entire shop scratching their heads; Joe has big plans for the '65 Nova, but a small space to work with.

videos.title: Iron Resurrection
videos.description: A customer wants to surprise his wife with major upgrades to her '68 Corvette convertible, but working with the fiberglass body soon brings on headaches that threaten both the car and the shop to crack under the pressure.

videos.title: Iron Resurrection
videos.description: The clock is ticking to complete a 1968 Corvette convertible, but messy fiberglass repairs uncover major collision damage; and if that wasn't enough, the customer also wants an all-white interior, which isn't a good fit for such a dirty job.

videos.title: Iron Resurrection
videos.description: A time capsule rolls into the shop in the form of a 1983 Silverado with exactly 69.2 miles on it; the owner recently passed away, and his daughter wants to finish turning his truck into a modern muscle car under the hood.

videos.title: Iron Resurrection
videos.description: Amanda and Shag stumble upon a '73 Vega with a rich history and a seller anxious to see his car restored to glory; they plan to chop the top and add an enormous engine, but first they must tackle over 40 years of rust and grime.

videos.title: Iron Resurrection
videos.description: Joe Martin brings new life to old iron at his shop Joe Martin Customs; working with his wife Amanda, and best friend Shag, this custom shop oversees every phase of restoration from design, fabrication and mechanicals, to the final paint job.

videos.title: Iron Resurrection
